text: Empirical EEG-fMRI study reports insomnia severity is associated with disrupted thalamocortical coupling, increased beta power, and altered default mode network connectivity.
Review evidence suggests reduced slow wave activity and altered spindle generation in insomnia and poor sleep quality measured by PSQI.

metadata.title: Slow wave and spindle abnormalities in sleep

text: Empirical DTI and MRI findings show lower thalamic radiation FA may support a white matter integrity mechanism related to insomnia severity.

metadata.title: White matter integrity and sleep quality
